parts.note: Scorpio is a sign of the zodiac

explanation.surface: An instruction to write a name inside a fish tank or military vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign' looks like a verb meaning write your name; it is the star sign. The Scorpion was a British Army light tank.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Scorpion is a model of armoured fighting vehicle used by the British Army.

definitions.meaning: to favour a policy is to speak in support of it
a lawyer presses a lawsuit in court, pleading a case

explanation.surface: Someone ironing a suit as a kindness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pressing a suit' suggests ironing clothes; it means pursuing a lawsuit.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to back a cause is to champion it, and a barrister arguing a case is its champion in court.

clue.text: Cold confection about to be included in selection

indicators.note: says the short word for about goes inside the word for selection

parts.note: a choice is a selection from options
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: A frozen treat picked out from an assortment.
explanation.definitionFit: A choc ice is a block of ice cream coated in chocolate, a frozen dessert sold in British shops.

clue.text: Walker losing one of their rights is still a walker

indicators.note: the walker is said to lose something, so letters are taken away from the word for a walker

parts.note: a rambler is a walker in the countryside
R is the abbreviation for right; the word has two, so one goes

explanation.surface: A hiker who has given up some entitlements still keeps on hiking.
explanation.walkthrough: RAMBLER has two Rs; dropping the first leaves a word that still means someone on foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone who strolls along at a leisurely pace is a walker.

parts.note: as means like, in the same way as
size is a gelatinous glue used to seal paper or plaster

explanation.surface: Glue-like evidence presented at a court case.
explanation.walkthrough: The Assizes were the old periodic criminal courts of England and Wales, held in each county.
explanation.definitionFit: Historical sense: an assize was a court sitting where cases were tried by a visiting judge.

definitions.meaning: a conductor stands turned towards the orchestra's scores
an idiom for owning up and taking the consequences

explanation.surface: Asking what the orchestra leader did, then whether that meant owning up.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to confront the unpleasant consequences of one's actions, taken literally of a conductor at the podium.

clue.text: Furniture seen on more than three hoardings?

definitions.text: Furniture seen on more than three hoardings?

parts.words: Furniture seen on more than three hoardings?
parts.note: hoardings carry posters, and more than three is four of them; a bed with four corner posts is the furniture

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture advertised across several billboards.
explanation.walkthrough: Hoardings are British billboards that carry posters; the clue reads a bed with four posts as four advertising posters.
explanation.definitionFit: Example of furniture: a large bed with a tall post at each corner, often supporting a canopy.

clue.text: Head may rave madly over a student — go ballistic here?

indicators.note: in a down clue the earlier pieces sit over the rest

parts.note: a cape is a headland jutting into the sea
can means may, be permitted to

indicators.note: madly says the letters of rave are scrambled

parts.note: L is the learner driver's plate, a student

explanation.surface: A boss who might fly into a rage at a pupil, i.e. go ballistic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madly' turns RAVE into AVER. 'go ballistic' sounds like losing one's temper but means launching missiles and rockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Location: the Florida spaceport is where ballistic missiles and rockets are launched, hence where things go ballistic.

parts.note: a quart is a liquid measure of two pints
the letter O is round

explanation.surface: Measuring around a sheet to find its dimensions.
explanation.definitionFit: A book or paper format made by folding a sheet twice, giving four leaves.

clue.text: Clio with plea confusing another Muse

indicators.note: mixing up these two words scrambles their letters into a new name

explanation.surface: One Muse muddling a plea gives a different Muse.
explanation.walkthrough: Clio, Muse of history, is in the clue; the anagram gives a different one of the nine.
explanation.definitionFit: Calliope, Muse of epic poetry, is one of the nine Muses of Greek myth, so another besides Clio.

parts.note: CH is Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: An honour bestowed on a Greek of independent mind.
explanation.definitionFit: Chi is the twenty-second letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in that script.

clue.text: Work by Timothy with article producing most favourable points

parts.note: op. is opus, a musical work
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A composition by someone called Timothy, with a written piece, scoring highly.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of optimum: the best or most favourable conditions or points.

clue.text: General acceptance of Mark e.g. in the past

definitions.meaning: an idea that has wide acceptance or prevalence
the German mark was money until the euro replaced it

explanation.surface: How widely a man named Mark was accepted in earlier times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like a man's name; it is the old German money.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: prevalence of an idea in common use, and money such as the former Deutschmark.

clue.text: Boy, he leaves here before ten

indicators.note: what is left comes ahead of the ten
he departs from the word here, so those letters drop out of it

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten

explanation.surface: A lad who departs this place before ten o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy's first name, Latin for king, as in the actor Rex Harrison.

parts.note: under means below

explanation.surface: An instruction to do things apart, as described further down.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: apart, into separate pieces, as in torn apart.

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is heard said, so the word for money is spoken

parts.note: dough is slang for money

explanation.surface: A banknote is cash, as people say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Note' suggests a banknote; it is the first note of the sol-fa scale.
explanation.definitionFit: In tonic sol-fa, the first note of the major scale, also spelt do.

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of still

parts.note: extant means still surviving

explanation.surface: A star-gazing device that is still in existence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'still' looks like part of the surface's 'still surviving'; only its first letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: A navigator's device measuring the angle between a star or the sun and the horizon.

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the rioter in trouble has its letters thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A one-time rioter in difficulties out in the open.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the outer surface or outside part of something.

parts.note: to tail someone is to follow them
pin means fix in place

explanation.surface: A decline seems to come after a repair.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a spinning dive of an aircraft, figuratively a rapid collapse or downward spiral.

definitions.meaning: to promote someone or improve something

explanation.surface: Tending towards promoting someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an uphill slope, and to promote to a higher rank or better version.

parts.note: an Israelite is a Jew
sharp means piercing, of a point or sound

explanation.surface: An Israelite carrying a sharp musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A small lyre-shaped instrument held between the teeth and plucked to make a twanging sound.

definitions.meaning: a pointed rod for holding meat while cooking

explanation.surface: Asking whether a spike is more slanted.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is a comparative of skew, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a kebab spike, and skew plus -er meaning more askew.

indicators.note: the scrambled word goes round the numeral
new means the letters of ideas are made into a new arrangement

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five

explanation.surface: Suggesting roughly five fresh notions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'roughly five'; it puts ADISE, the anagram of IDEAS, around V.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to counsel or suggest a course of action.

clue.text: Take most of this on previous day

indicators.note: most of means all but the final letter

parts.note: the eve is the day before a festival

explanation.surface: Accept most of this on the day before.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to steal, to take what is not yours.

clue.text: Character giving command to speed up

definitions.meaning: the call to make a horse go faster

explanation.surface: A person who tells others to hurry.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the name of the letter G, and the rider's word to urge a horse on.

explanation.surface: The Spectator, a weekly magazine, said to come out each Sunday.
explanation.walkthrough: The Spectator is a British weekly magazine, misleading here; The Observer is a British Sunday newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a watcher or onlooker, and the name of the oldest Sunday paper in Britain.

indicators.note: the man's name holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: Rory is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man taking in some South American beads.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosary is a string of prayer beads used in Catholic devotion.

clue.text: Misbehaving oldsters liked to be dolled up

indicators.note: the old folk behaving badly signals that the letters run riot

explanation.surface: Unruly pensioners enjoyed getting glammed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: wearing striking clothes designed to impress, glamorously dressed.
